lines: 黑水城，南郊破院。
林舒意识有些涣散，想要睁开眼看看，眼皮却像被米浆糊住了一般。
“接着打。”
耳畔忽然响起粗粝嗓音，让他稍微清醒了一些。
又闹起来了？要打谁？
林舒下意识伸手想要抓点什么。
打架这种事情，必须得有件趁手的家伙才行，不然要吃大亏的。
他处理这种事情的经验再丰富不过，否则也没法在那肮脏的街巷里摸爬滚打活到今天。
啪！啪！
然而还没等林舒的手伸出去，肩背上便是被狠狠抽了两鞭子，皮肉被硬生生撕裂。
宿醉后的昏沉瞬间褪去，在剧痛的刺激下，林舒终于睁开了眼睛，糊眼的米浆是猩红颜色，连带着整个视野都呈现模糊暗红的模样。
原来……是他妈的打我啊。
意识接管身躯，那遍体鳞伤的痛感瞬间侵入大脑。
林舒的呼吸变得颤抖而急促，双臂肌肤也因为兴奋恐惧而随之紧绷。
他舔了舔破皮的嘴角，用舌尖将血渍卷入口腔，缓缓抬头看去。
周遭环境陌生到极点，简陋的土墙小院，与自己熟悉的的肮脏街巷和高楼大厦截然不同。
映入视线的少说也有十余人，男女老幼都有。
最引人注目的莫过于前方的三条壮汉。
三人全都打着赤膊，脸上涂着怪异夸张的油墨。
领头的那个蓄了短须，另外两人则是手里攥着皮鞭，眼神阴冷的俯瞰而来。
“鞭子？”
林舒强忍剧痛，冷静观察着一切。
谁家打架会用这种东西。
这玩意儿要么是用来执行惩戒，要么就是用来调情的。
看了眼这三条大汉，林舒更希望是前者。
他视线下移，来到了与自己平齐的地面，那里躺着一个染血的麻布口袋，从轮廓来看，里面像是装了一头类似猿猴的活物，还在细微蠕动。
以这麻袋为锚点，散碎记忆瞬间聚拢。
此地是一个戏班子的落脚处，这群人以坑蒙拐骗为生。
前身是被他们从郊外捡回来的。
由于身形修长，皮肤白净，专门负责扮演仙神，哄点赏钱。
不久前戏班子盯上了一个老妪，打听清楚这人家里有个患病孙儿，只能以汤药吊命后，不由生出了歹心。
先劝对方停了汤药，又捏造了几件仙迹，最后将老妪带到了扮成仙神的前身面前。
轻轻松松就骗走了这老太婆的全部家财。
本来事情到这里就结束了。
谁成想前身不忍害那孩子性命。
他竟然偷摸溜了出去，想劝那老妪别断了孩子的药汤，至于银子的事情，他愿意陪着对方去报官。
林舒嘴角抽搐了一下。
摊上这么个蠢东西，那是真没招了。
他盯着麻袋。
半掩的袋口里，隐约能看见一张血肉模糊的老脸。

Blackwater City, a ruined courtyard in the southern suburbs.
Lin Shu's consciousness was a little blurred, and he wanted to open his eyes to take a look, but his eyelids seemed to be covered with rice paste.
"Keep fighting."
A rough voice suddenly sounded in his ears, making him wake up a little.
Making trouble again? Who to fight?
Lin Shu subconsciously stretched out his hand to grab something.
For things like fighting, you must have someone who can take advantage of it, otherwise you will suffer big losses.
He couldn't have more experience in dealing with this kind of thing, otherwise he wouldn't be able to survive today in those dirty streets.
Snap! Snap!
However, before Lin Shu could reach out his hand, he was whipped twice hard on his shoulder and back, and his skin and flesh were torn apart.
"Hiss!"
The hangover drowsiness faded away in an instant. Stimulated by the severe pain, Lin Shu finally opened his eyes. The rice milk that smeared his eyes was scarlet, and the entire field of vision was blurred and dark red.
It turns out...he was fucking hitting me.
Consciousness took over the body, and the pain all over his body invaded his brain instantly.
Lin Shu's breathing became shaky and rapid, and the skin on his arms became tense due to excitement and fear.
He licked the broken corners of his mouth, rolled the blood into his mouth with the tip of his tongue, and slowly looked up.
The surrounding environment was extremely unfamiliar. The simple mud-walled courtyard was completely different from the dirty streets and high-rise buildings that I was familiar with.
There were at least a dozen people who came into sight, including men, women, old and young.
The most eye-catching thing is the three strong men in front.
All three of them were shirtless, with weird and exaggerated ink on their faces.
The leader had a short beard, while the other two held whips in their hands and looked down with cold eyes.
"Whip?"
Lin Shu endured the severe pain and calmly observed everything.
Who would use this kind of thing in a fight?
This thing is either used for punishment or for flirting.
After looking at these three big men, Lin Shu hoped it was the former.
He moved his eyes downward and came to the ground level with himself, where lay a blood-stained linen bag. Judging from the outline, it seemed to contain a living creature similar to an ape, which was still squirming slightly.
Using this sack as an anchor, scattered memories are instantly gathered together.
This place is the home of a theater troupe, a group of people who make a living by cheating and kidnapping.
The predecessor was picked up from the suburbs.
Because of his slender figure and fair skin, he specializes in playing the role of a god and coaxing some rewards.
Not long ago, the theater troupe focused on an old woman. After finding out that this woman had a sick grandson in her family and could only die with decoction, she couldn't help but have evil intentions.
First, he persuaded the other party to stop the decoction, then fabricated a few fairy tales, and finally brought the old woman to the predecessor dressed as a fairy.
He easily defrauded the old woman of all her wealth.
Originally, the matter ended here.
Who would have thought that my predecessor couldn't bear to harm that child's life.
He actually sneaked out, trying to persuade the old woman not to cut off the child's medicine. As for the money matter, he was willing to accompany her to report it to the official.
"This."
Lin Shu's mouth twitched.
There is really no way to deal with such a stupid thing.
He stared at the sack.
In the half-covered bag mouth, an old face with bloody flesh could be vaguely seen.
